name: animate_model
description: Animate a rigged 3D model with 1 to 5 of Tripo's preset animations, baked into the .glb. A task already submitted (a run that stopped or ran out of time names its id) is collected with task-id: no new task, no new charge; never run the step again to get it. The model must come from rig_model; a plain .glb is refused. Each id is checked against the rig's list before any call. Biped rigs take preset:biped:<name> (walk, run, idle, dance_01, ...); creature rigs take preset:quadruped:walk, preset:hexapod:walk, preset:octopod:walk, preset:serpentine:march or preset:aquatic:march. Plays in place by default. Standalone.

output.description: Path to the animated .glb. With --json: {path, taskId, animations, inPlace, creditsUsed, textures}.

params.name: model
params.description: The rigged .glb to animate (made by rig_model, with its .tripo.json beside it). Required unless task-id.

params.name: animation
params.description: A preset animation id, such as preset:biped:walk (repeat for up to 5). Valid ids depend on the rig. Required unless --task-id.

params.name: out
params.description: Output .glb path. Optional with _project: saved in the project's assets folder.

params.name: root-motion
params.description: Keep the animation's own travel (a walk moves forward). Off by default: the animation plays in place and the scene moves the character.

params.name: task-id
params.description: Collect a task already submitted (the id a run that stopped or ran out of time names): wait for it and download it. No new task, no new charge; no model or animation needed.
